name: scotiabank.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 5 front-end libraries have known flaws.
lesson: Check front-end library versions against a known-flaw list on every release, and upgrade the ones that are flagged.
summary: www.scotiabank.com scores 71 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 32 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: 24 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 24 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /ca/en/personal.html, /global/en/country/aruba.html, /global/en/country/australia.html, /global/en/country/bonaire.html and 14 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Adobe Analytics (11 requests), Google Ads (4 requests), Quantcast (2 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), X Ads (1 request), and cookies demdex on demdex.net, dpm on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 5 front-end libraries have known flaws
fix.evidence: ua-parser-js 0.7.10 (read from the page): 3 known flaws, the worst rated high, such as CVE-2020-7733, CVE-2020-7793. Regular Expression Denial of Service in ua-parser-js. DOMPurify 3.4.1 (banner of…
fix.fix: Upgrade ua-parser-js to 0.7.23 or later; upgrade DOMPurify to 3.4.16 or later; upgrade Moment.js to 2.31.0 or later; upgrade React to 16.4.2 or later.

fix.title: 12 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /global/en/global-site.html, /global/en/country/aruba.html, /global/en/country/australia.html, /global/en/country/bonaire.html and 8 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
